description: This file defines a class 'StreamingHistoryGrain' that implements Orleans grain interfaces and handles stream subscription, message reception, and unsubscription logic for testing streaming history functionality.

classes.name: StreamingHistoryGrain
classes.description: A test grain class that manages stream subscriptions and message handling for testing streaming history in Orleans.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream as a consumer, with optional filter data.

methods.name: GetReceivedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of received stream items.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Unsubscribes the grain from all streams it is currently subscribed to.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items and adds them to the received items list.
